title: Information-theoretic Limits of Learning and Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2605.06710v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Information theory plays a central role in establishing fundamental limits on what any learning or estimation algorithm can -- and cannot -- achieve, regardless of computational power. This draft provides an introduction to these connections. We begin by introducing concentration inequalities along with the notions of covering and packing in metric spaces, and the associated concept of metric entropy. These tools are essential for our analysis. We then introduce the learning-theoretic framework and derive upper bounds on generalization error in terms of metric entropy, Rademacher complexity, and the VC dimension, as well as mutual information and relative entropy. Finally we discuss the minimax estimation framework and establish lower bounds on minimax risk using Fano's inequality, yielding bounds in terms of relative entropy and covering and packing numbers. translated_title: 学习与估计的信息论极限
translated_abstract: 信息论在确定任何学习或估计算法所能达到——以及不能达到——的基本极限方面发挥着核心作用，且这种极限与计算能力无关。本文稿为这些联系提供了一个入门介绍。我们首先介绍集中不等式，以及度量空间中覆盖与填充的概念及相关的度量熵概念，这些工具对我们的分析至关重要。随后，我们介绍学习理论框架，并推导出泛化误差的上界，其表达形式涉及度量熵、Rademacher复杂度、VC维，以及互信息和相对熵。最后，我们讨论极小极大估计框架，并利用Fano不等式建立极小极大风险的下界，得到以相对熵以及覆盖数和填充数表示的界。本稿件的一个大幅修订和扩充版本即将发布。
tldr: 本文系统介绍了集中不等式、度量熵、Fano不等式等信息论工具如何刻画学习与估计算法的基本极限，包括基于度量熵、Rademacher复杂度和VC维的泛化误差上界，以及基于相对熵和覆盖/填充数的极小极大风险下界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces how information-theoretic tools—concentration inequalities, metric entropy, and Fano's inequality—characterize fundamental limits of learning and estimation, yielding generalization error upper bounds in terms of metric entropy, Rademacher complexity, and VC dimension, as well as minimax risk lower bounds in terms of relative entropy and covering/packing numbers.
